found.title: Ts and Cs (Silver Oak Capital terms of business PDF)
found.summary: Terms of business PDF for arranging services in respect of financial facilities. Per the search tool's summary: dated May 2024, version 2; company is Silver Oak Capital Ltd, London, company number 08551479; parties defined as SOC ('We') and the client, connected entity or attorney ('You'); written for consumers considering certain financial products. Fee agreement: SOC provides a brokerage service (independent recommendations and arranging financial facilities) in consideration of an Arrangement Fee; fee and charge structures may vary and all fee/charge details are set out in a client-specific Fee Agreement. Commission disclosure: no snippet stated whether commission is paid. Complaints: complaints go to the Managing Director in writing or by phone; if unresolved the client may be entitled to refer the matter to the Financial Ombudsman Service. Data protection: the firm has safeguards against unauthorised or unlawful processing; consent to ongoing processing can be withdrawn; people can opt out of communications at any time; the Data Protection Officer contact is Connor.dooley@silveroakcapital.co.uk.
verbatim: Please contact The Data Protection Officer at Connor.dooley@silveroakcapital.co.uk.
SOC will provide to the Client in consideration of the Arrangement Fee, a brokerage service

found.title: Silver Oak Capital (Development Finance Scorecard)
found.summary: Developer scorecard tool on a subdomain. Per the search tool's summary: a 'Development Finance Scorecard' that benchmarks a project against five categories and produces an overall score, pitched as a way to gauge how ready a developer is to raise finance; a short questionnaire; the report is then emailed, after which the user can request a free consultation to talk through the results. Query 8's summary described the subdomain home page as a property-finance pitch aimed at developers offering a free 'funding ready' analysis.
found.notes: Surfaced by queries 2, 6 and 8. Only these two short phrases were shown as exact strings; the rest is the tool's paraphrase. Per the tool, none of the main-domain pages returned by query 6 (property-development-finance, contact, home, faq, blogs, case studies) mention the scorecard, so the tool is described only on this subdomain.
